channel.title: DR Congo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from DR Congo, every source cited.

item.title: Adfs free nearly 50 hostages in Ituri
item.description: Nearly 50 people held for weeks by ADF rebels have regained their freedom in the Malembi forest.

item.title: Bill Clinton Foundation warns of Ndolo prison overcrowding
item.description: The foundation urges Congolese authorities to take urgent action to alleviate severe overcrowding at the Ndolo military prison.

item.title: Cholera response strained by shortages and strikes in Equateur
item.description: The Equateur provincial health division reports 142 cases and 17 deaths amid a lack of medicine and striking staff.

item.title: DR Congo musician Gally Garvey briefly held for traffic offenses
item.description: Police in Kinshasa detained the artist Gally Garvey on Monday, November 2, 2026, for serious traffic violations.

item.title: Judith Suminwa calls for women's peace role in DR Congo
item.description: The Prime Minister urged women to be central actors for peace in the Great Lakes region.
